findings.issue: לקח is qal perfect 3ms and the relative is its object; «que tomó» makes the woman the one who takes.
The noun is the fronted object of 3ms לקח; «mujer cusita tomó» makes her the subject.
The verb is piel wayyiqtol 3fs before the compound subject; plural «hablaron» is agreement smoothing and keeps both speakers.

notes: ב, על־אדות, כי, gentilicio cusita, and the repeated לקח stay open; the two לקח clauses reverse who acts.
